notes: Report "Artikelstatistik", Mandant 2KCO (KITZ COMP.+ OFFICE), Datum 02.09.2026, 5 pages, Per./Kum. total 204,00 Menge / 197.621,93 Wert. Marks are handwritten at the far right of each row in blue pen. Distinction: "check" = a clear tick/Haken (customer confirmed still exists); "dot" = a small dot/point (existence unsure); several rows have ambiguous small ink marks that could be either — those are flagged per-row via mark="other" when a symbol is present but not clearly a tick or a dot. Strike-through detection: struck rows have a horizontal line through Kontonr+Name+figures (typically rows with negative/correction amounts, duplicates, or closed customers). Handwritten page footers appear to be tally counts (e.g. page1 "421 ... 18 ... 52", page5 "421 2"). Low-confidence marks: many right-end symbols are tiny and smudged; distinguishing check vs dot is inherently uncertain on a scan. Where a row is struck AND has no clear right-end mark, mark="none". Mark-meaning convention observed: clear V-shaped strokes = "check" (customer confirmed to still exist); small compact ink blobs/short diagonal loops next to the date = "dot" (existence unsure). Struck-through rows carry no personal right-end mark (mark=none) — those are customers treated as gone.

Uncertainties / judgment calls:
- The three ZEPPITZ rows (27839) and the F&S LEASING cluster at the bottom of page 2 are tied together with long bracket/brace strokes rather than individual symbols. I read the ZEPPITZ bracket terminals as checkmarks (clear V hooks). The 9 bracketed F&S LEASING rows (the ±3009,16 / ±2890 / ±2290 correction pairs) are joined only by a vertical grouping brace with no individual check or dot, so I set mark="other" for those; the two standalone F&S rows above the brace (29.10.2010 and the first 30.07.2010 line) each have an individual dot.
- Row 271607 (FRISIERSALON PETELIN, struck) sits just under the big checkmark that actually belongs to the row below it (271428 RISTORANTE PIZZERIA CIAO CIAO). I attributed that check to 271428 and left 271607 as struck/none.
- Several struck rows on page 1 (270644, 270887 x2, 13.12.2011/07.12.2011/30.11.2011 cluster) have a horizontal line/arrow extending right — part of the strike-through, not a separate symbol; recorded as struck/none.
- Customer names read from the scan; a few OCR-ish spellings may be off (e.g. "****AL MULINO GASTRO GMBH" has literal leading asterisks on the page; "LANDHAUS PAPITSCH XXXXXX" has an obscured/blurred suffix). Kontonr values were legible and are reliable.
- "struck" set true only where the row is unambiguously crossed out; ambiguous rows left false.
